## next

1. M: decide the release (version bump + notes) carrying the three unreleased output changes (qc-summary strand columns, length-dist output, smoothed_deletion) — maintainer decision

## recommendation

1. M: notify downstream consumers of the additive schema changes in one notice — error.parquet now 10 columns (first Float64/nullable), qc-summary 18 columns plus the optional length-dist file
2. L: prefer read-time column projection (polars/duckdb `columns=`/SELECT) over a writer-side column-selection flag — parquet readers prune column chunks natively
3. L: whole-file strand counts need no sam-tagger run — `samtools view -c -f 16` / `-F 16` covers them
